name: AVIC Shenyang Aircraft Company Limited
summary: AVIC Shenyang Aircraft Company Limited manufactures and markets aviation products in China. It offers aviation defense equipment, military aircraft, and civil aviation products; and aircraft maintenance services. The company was formerly known as Zhonghangheibao Co.,Ltd. AVIC Shenyang Aircraft Company Limited was founded in 1993 and is based in Shenyang, China. AVIC Shenyang Aircraft Company Limited is a subsidiary of Aviation Industry Corporation of China,Ltd.
